purpose: Reusable map of the radio/PHY identity+revision model used by the vendor AC-PHY blob for BCM4352 (AC, radio BCM2069). ANALYSIS ONLY.

primary_identity_source.type: PHY/radio register window at pi+0x148, accessed via external osl_readw/osl_writew

radio_indirect_pair_on_bcm4352.addr_latch: pi+0x148 + 0x3d8 (16-bit write selects the radio register)
radio_indirect_pair_on_bcm4352.data: pi+0x148 + 0x3da (16-bit read returns the selected radio register)
radio_indirect_pair_on_bcm4352.alternate_window: pi+0x148 + 0x3f6/0x3f8/0x3fa used when [[pi+0x20]+0x28] == 0x1B or <= 0x17 (NOT this board)

fields.name: radioid (radio chip id)
consumers: wlc_phy_attach @0xbf02f..0xbf106: compared to radio-id constants per phytype; AC accepts {0x030B, 0x2069} (a mismatch calls wlc_phy_switch_radio(pi,0) and takes the attach error path)
sub_9fb72 @0x9fc89: == 0x2069 selects the 2069 revision jump table

fields.name: radio_rev (full 2069 revision byte)
consumers: sub_9fb72 @0x9fc92: index = R-3 (R in [3,38]) -> jump table selecting prefregs_2069_rev3/4/16/17/18/23/24/25/26/33_37/20691_rev1
sub_9fb72 @0xa02b4 (chain loop, table base chosen by rev)

fields.name: radio_major_rev_class
fields.consumers: see docs/m34d4/pll_selector_provenance.json (switch_radio_acphy, sub_9fb72, radio_override_acphy, attach_acphy, tempsense, stf_chain_temp_throttle, rx_iq_est, tx_tone, get_spurmode)
fields.branch_meaning: 1 = 2069 rev 16..31 (PLL sequence A); 2 = rev 32..47 (PLL sequence B); 0 = rev 0..15; 15 = rev254 special

fields.name: phytype
fields.consumers: radio reg-window selection (read_radio_reg), AC path gating (==0x0B), radio-id acceptance table

fields.name: phyrev
fields.board_value: low nibble 0x0A (full D11 PHY rev 0x2A/42 per M3.4D3A1)

notes: radioid is radio reg 1; radio_rev/class is radio reg 0.
The AC path reads reg 0 and reg 1 only (no reg 2).
No NVRAM/SPROM 'radiorev'/'radioid' override string exists in the blob; the values are hardware identity.
